explanation: The statement concerns the library-local endomorphism `smulHom s M` of a sheaf of modules (defined in this file as the multiply-by-resTop-section endomorphism), and asserts that it commutes with any morphism φ. Mathlib has no such construction: `scheme.Modules` only provides `M.smul r : Γ(M,U) →+* End Γ(M,U)` (Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Modules/Sheaf.lean:102) and `Hom.app_smul` (line 125), which are sectionwise statements about scalar multiplication, not the composability of a global-section endomorphism functor. Searching Mathlib for `smulHom`, `app_smul`, `map_comp_smul`, `smulEnd`/`smulEndo` and related names turned up no declaration of this composite identity. The library's proof uses the Mathlib lemma `Hom.app_smul` (together with its own `smulHom_app_apply`), but the theorem's content lies in the library's own definition `smulHom`, so it is not an instance of a single Mathlib declaration; deriving it would require the local definition plus a `Scheme.Modules`-level `ext`, i.e. more than routine instantiation.
